headline: Good morning — the RBA has lifted the cash rate to 4.85 per cent, an 18-year high, while home values fall for a seventh month and Cyclone Murasu batters Andhra Pradesh.

highlights.label: RBA hike
highlights.text: The Reserve Bank raised the cash rate 25 basis points to 4.85 per cent, its fifth increase this year.

highlights.label: Housing slide
highlights.text: Cotality's national home value index fell 1.2 per cent in October, a seventh straight monthly decline.

highlights.label: Cyclone Murasu
highlights.text: Cyclone Murasu made landfall near Ongole in Andhra Pradesh, cancelling flights and closing schools across coastal districts.

tip.title: Take a two-minute movement break each hour
tip.body: Stand up and walk, climb a flight of stairs or do a few bodyweight squats once an hour. Short, regular breaks interrupt long periods of sitting and help with stiffness and energy through the afternoon. Set a recurring reminder so it becomes automatic.

quote.text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
quote.author: Confucius

items.title: Salesforce's Braze deal puts marketers at an ecosystem crossroads
items.summary: Salesforce has agreed to acquire customer engagement platform Braze in a deal valued at about US$5.7 billion, pending approvals. Marketers now have to weigh closer ties to one vendor's ecosystem against independent alternatives.

items.title: Braze rivals stress independence after Salesforce deal
items.summary: Commentary on the Salesforce-Braze deal looks at what it means for email and customer engagement providers. Competitors are emphasising their independence, which may shape vendor selection and renewals.

items.title: HubSpot introduces AI spend caps and pay-as-you-go billing
items.summary: HubSpot shares rallied on 22 October amid speculation about software M&A. Separately, HubSpot reportedly added AI spend controls and usage-based billing in mid-October, which affects how marketers budget for AI features. This is older than 48 hours.

items.title: Adobe Journey Optimizer adds action-level email overrides
items.summary: Adobe added the ability to override email configuration at the individual action level in Journey Optimizer. It gives teams finer control over sender settings inside a journey. This is older than 48 hours.

items.title: Martech consolidation and infrastructure in focus
items.summary: Analysis of the Braze-Salesforce deal places it in a wider wave of martech consolidation. It suggests marketing stacks may increasingly be built around fewer, larger platforms.

items.title: Salesforce agrees to buy AI service startup Cresta
items.summary: Salesforce announced a deal to acquire AI customer-service startup Cresta, reportedly for about US$2.7 billion, and shares fell on the day. Price details are as reported and not independently confirmed.

items.title: Salesforce signs deal to acquire Loops
items.summary: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Loops, an AI analytics platform tied to Tableau. A listing note indicates the deal closed on 2 November 2026.

items.title: Salesforce to acquire Braze for US$5.66 billion
items.summary: Salesforce announced on 20 October that it will buy Braze to strengthen customer engagement. The deal still needs regulatory and shareholder approval.

items.title: Agentforce deployments surge amid 'pilot purgatory' concerns
items.summary: Salesforce reported a sharp rise in Agentforce deployments to counter fears that AI projects stall at pilot stage. This is an older story with no firm 48-hour date.

items.title: Dreamforce 2026 highlights: job-specific agents and CRM reasoning model
items.summary: A partner blog summarises Dreamforce announcements including seven job-specific agents and a reasoning model. This is a secondary source and older than 48 hours, so check Salesforce's newsroom before relying on details.

sfstatus.statusNote: No November 2026 incident reports were found and status.salesforce.com could not be checked directly, so current status is unconfirmed.

items.title: Marketing Cloud Engagement feature degradation on 5 October
items.summary: A brief Marketing Cloud Engagement degradation of about 19 minutes was logged on 5 October. This is older than 48 hours and shown for context only.

items.title: Marketing Cloud Engagement database outage on 18 September
items.summary: A Marketing Cloud Engagement database became unreachable and was restored after a restart, with about 3 hours of impact reported. This is older and shown for context only.

items.title: Opposition says PM and Treasurer 'in denial' after RBA hike
items.summary: Opposition leader Angus Taylor blamed the government for the RBA's rate rise to an 18-year high. Albanese rejected that and pointed to the Coalition's refusal to back savings measures.

items.title: Albanese arrives at CHOGM in Antigua and Barbuda
items.summary: The prime minister is at the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting. The Coalition has questioned the trip while households face cost-of-living pressure.

items.title: US midterm results and the risk to Australia's shaky economy
items.summary: David Speers examines whether the Democratic midterm result could flow through to Australia's already fragile economy. It adds to uncertainty around trade and markets.

items.title: Albanese defends regional work rule for British backpackers
items.summary: Albanese defended reinstating a regional work requirement for British backpackers, saying numbers were affecting local jobs. The comments came during the CHOGM trip.

items.title: Government signals no spending is off limits in search for savings
items.summary: The government says no area of spending is exempt as it looks for budget savings to help fight inflation. The Coalition is being pressed to say where it would cut.

items.title: Delhi wakes to smog as Diwali shopping rush builds
items.summary: Delhi's air quality index read about 373 on the morning of 4 November, with Punjabi Bagh near 452. Gurugram and Noida also reported very poor air. Figures are from a live news page.

items.title: Cabinet extends fast-track courts for sexual offence cases to 2031
items.summary: The Union Cabinet extended fast-track courts for rape and child sexual abuse trials until 2031, with the target raised to 850 courts. It aims to speed up case disposal.

items.title: Supreme Court: foreign divorce on irretrievable breakdown not enforceable in India
items.summary: A daily digest reports the court held that a foreign divorce granted only on irretrievable breakdown cannot be enforced in India. Details are from a summary, not the judgment.

items.title: DRDO test-fires Pralay missile
items.summary: India's DRDO conducted a test-firing of the Pralay missile, per a daily digest. Not independently confirmed.

items.title: US midterms offer little immediate relief on trade for India
items.summary: A UNI digest item says the US midterm results bring little immediate relief for India on tariffs and trade. The item is a headline only, with limited detail.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu makes landfall near Ongole
items.summary: The cyclone crossed the south Andhra coast with winds of about 110 km/h, gusting to 120 km/h. At least 19 flights were cancelled across Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam and Tirupati.

items.title: Schools shut and red alerts issued as Murasu hits coast
items.summary: Red alerts were issued for six districts and schools were closed. Flights were delayed at major airports, with disruption expected to continue.

items.title: Naidu surveys cyclone-hit areas by air
items.summary: The chief minister inspected affected areas in Guntur, Bapatla and Prakasam and ordered waterlogging cleared in towns including Chirala and Parchur. Quick drainage is key to limiting crop and housing damage.

items.title: PM Modi phones Naidu on cyclone damage
items.summary: Naidu raised broader central aid for farming, roads and power, and flagged severe drought in Rayalaseema. A central team has been asked to report within 15 days.

items.title: Naidu tells officials to brace for another cyclone
items.summary: The chief minister directed readiness for a further weather system after earlier storm damage. The report may be slightly older than 48 hours.

items.title: Chip stocks lift the Nasdaq while Apple drags the Dow
items.summary: US shares ended mixed on 3 November, with semiconductor stocks rebounding and Apple weighing on the Dow. The Nasdaq-100 remains in correction territory, about 10 per cent below its recent high.

items.title: Democrats sweep midterms; futures fall after the close
items.summary: Stock futures turned lower in the evening as traders priced in strong Democratic wins. Political change may affect policy expectations for markets.

items.title: Markets edge higher as semiconductor stocks rebound
items.summary: AMD and Arista Networks jumped after the close on sales above their own forecasts. Oil also fell during the session.

items.title: Share market ends higher after 'no-surprise' rate hike
items.summary: The RBA lifted the cash rate 25 basis points to 4.85 per cent on 3 November, as widely expected. The local market closed higher on hopes of a pause. Other reports differ on the exact day's move.

items.title: ASX 200 slides below 8,830 on US midterm jitters and RBA hike
items.summary: The benchmark fell about 0.7 per cent on Wednesday afternoon, led by financials and healthcare. Investors were also watching the US midterm outcome. The figure is an intraday reading, not a close.

items.title: Australian dollar ticks up after RBA hike
items.summary: The Australian dollar moved around 70 US cents after the 25 basis point increase. Reports on the day's direction vary, so check a live quote.

items.title: Australian shares slip after RBA hike hits banks
items.summary: Banks weighed on the market after the fifth rate rise of 2026. Higher borrowing costs are a risk for lenders and borrowers alike.

items.title: National home values fall 1.2 per cent in October
items.summary: Cotality's index fell for a seventh straight month and sits about 6.7 per cent below its March peak. Brisbane and Perth led the declines.

items.title: Housing downturn broadens as Brisbane and Perth lead declines
items.summary: Cotality says falls are spreading across more markets amid weak consumer confidence. It expects subdued conditions through the rest of 2026.

items.title: Home values slide ahead of expected RBA hike
items.summary: The October fall came before the RBA's 3 November increase to 4.85 per cent. Further rate pressure could deepen the slowdown.

items.title: RBA decision lifts rates to an 18-year high
items.summary: Mortgage holders face higher repayments after the fifth hike of the year. Lenders typically pass on rises within weeks.

items.title: Auction clearance rates remain weak
items.summary: The combined capitals clearance rate was 44.1 per cent for the week ending 11 October. This is the latest weekly figure found and is older than 48 hours.
